name: Gear generator
description: Creates a parametric involute spur gear at the origin: a native sketch and extrude, so the design opens without the plugin.

module.description: Module: the pitch diameter is module * teeth.

pressure_angle.description: Pressure angle at the pitch circle. The common values are 14.5, 20 and 25.

thickness.description: Face width: how far the gear is extruded.

bore_diameter.description: Bore diameter, 0 for a gear without a bore.

name.description: Name of the sketch, the extrude and the body.
